text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliamentary panel, foreign minister to meet on Saturday to discuss the issue of some 600 Kuwaitis that the Gulf state says are still detained in Iraq since the 1990-91 Gulf crisis.
- Kuwait Petroleum Corporation (KPC) plans to build new headquarters worth about 12 million dinars ($40.0 million).
- Kuwait Real Estate Bank seen increasing its capital in March.
- Reshuffle at the Ministry of Public Works after some six months, minister says.
- Human Rights parliamentary committee to visit deportation centre on Sunday.
- Parliament's Interior and Defence committee to discuss the issue of stateless people after the end of the Moslem fasting month.
- Kuwait targets 3.0 million barrels per day oil production capacity.
- Prime minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah stresses the importance of national unity.
